queryStatements#2.description:
Models whose Query operation runs `UPDATE SET ... WHERE ...` and `DELETE WHERE ...` statements, by model
identifier (`"*"` for every other exposed model), and how their rows are written:

- `"bulk"`: with the repository `updateMany` / `deleteMany`, restricted to the rows the caller may act on. No
  per-object repository event is emitted and the model `patch()` / `delete()` methods are not called;
- `"events"`: object by object through the model, like the `Patch` and `Delete` operations: repository events
  are emitted and the model methods run;
- `false`: refused (to take a model out of `"*"`).

A model that is not listed refuses statements (400), as before. Statements need the `Patch` (UPDATE) or `Delete`
(DELETE) operation of the model to be allowed for the caller, and check `canAct` on every row.

exposeMe.description: Expose current user in the context with me

exposeOperations.description:
Operations exposed as GraphQL fields next to the model schema, with the operation transports' patterns:
`"*"`, `"Service.*"`, an exact id, `"!Id"` to exclude; `[]` exposes no operation

globalSubscription.description: Expose a aggregation of all available subscriptions

maxOperationsPerRequest.description: Max number of requests allowed within a graphql query or mutation

models.description:
List of models to include

If model is prefixed with a ! it will be excluded

nameTransfomer.description: Transform the name of the model to be used in the URL

queryHydrateMaxDepth.description: Deepest relation path a query can hydrate (`HYDRATE project.team` has a depth of two), between 1 and 5

queryHydrateMaxObjects.description: Most distinct related objects one query can load with `HYDRATE`: a query loading more is refused (400)
